notes.title: Release 1.2.0.8
notes.notes:
Hi There,

thanks to your feedback and contribution, that's outstanding
Now I am ready to ship release 1.2.0.8 including TRADIND CARDS

Release contains
- You needed to escape the message window to terminate the dialogue
- Beam effect only worked with wooden sword
- The skill range didn't apply to enemies
- some minor glitches here and there
- The boring error sound at title screen
- Code now works
And previous release content
ADDED
- Screen resolution increase to 1280x720
- You can now custom your keyboard also for moving keys (left.right, up and down)
- A Strafe mode is added (so you can aim using bows)
- There's a full screen option in the menu
- A new damage pop-up system
- Some swords throw energy like zelda's sword
- If you maintain the strike button....well you'll see 

Good game
Feel free to contact me ! Really !
Geex Games

notes.title: How can you get a key for a Friend
notes.notes:
I always listen to gamers, as it's hell and pain as an indie ton my own to create and fully test a action-RPG

that's why, if you find a bug, AND if you help me fixing it, I will offer you a steam key for a friend.

of course, I would need to recognize your bug as a real bug and it would need to be a new one I haven't yet identified, AND it must be a bug which enable the gamer to play.

Good luck.

KNOWN BUGS SO FAR
All fixex included in version release note of course and...
Crash when full screen mode is activated (Fixed in release 1.2)
Crash when using the Horn (Fixed in 1.2.0.6)
Crash during the first Darkness cinematic (Fixed in 1.2.0.6)
Hero stuck forever while moving from Alcim to Arlan (Fixed in 1.2.0.6)
Overlay issue with some config and game crash (Needs re-installation of XNA, -ne ramework)
Escape to release the message instead of action (Fixed in 1.2.0.7)
Click may work when the application has not the focus (???)

notes.title: RELEASE 1.2 IS READY WITH MORE FEATURES !
notes.notes:
VERSION 1.2

Thanks a lot for your feedback so far
Here are some improvements I've made for release 1.2 :

ADDED
- Screen resolution increase to 1280x720

- You can now custom your keyboard also for moving keys (left.right, up and down)

- A Strafe mode is added (so you can aim using bows)

- There's a full screen option in the menu

- A new damage pop-up system

- Some swords throw energy like zelda's sword

- If you maintain the strike button....well you'll see


FIXED
- A small bug with Music off mode is fixed. Sometimes music replayed despite the music mode was off

- Full action swing animation for swords and bows, spear etc

- A weapon remaining on screen bug is fixed

- When selecting the second weapon or skills, the HUD didn't refresh.

- Mighty energy in the Dungeon was not reachable

- Fullscreen mode crashes

VIDEO

ROUND 1
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QikKuMdY_SE&feature=youtu.be

ROUND 2
https://youtu.be/1wmp9DmzTwg

Feel free to contact me or leave a positive review if you like the game

notes.title: Gamer's Choice
notes.notes:
Hello,
I am trying to improve the game experience on and on listening to gamers feedback

I want to upgrade the resolution to a standard resolution that would allow you to play full screen
What's your preference
1280*720 (cool but pretty big compared to npc size?) ?
800*600  (rather standard)`?

As you can see I was lacking a 2D spriter to create the hero's animation.
Do you think it's worth to try and pay a PRO for doing the animation ?
Not really, the experience is quite enough.
